parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, slender and lightweight, typically around 10 cm long.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the central axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central pivot once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum, longer and thinner than the hour hand, typically around 15 cm long.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the central axis once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central pivot once every 60 minutes.

parts.name: Clock Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the main surface or dial of the clock, made of stainless steel, circular in shape with a diameter of about 30 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the background for the clock hands and may include markings or holes to indicate hours.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the rotating hands and clock mechanism.
